purpose: Teach: 祐/俊/吾/遙/諒/ゆり/綾/朱

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の祐くんを連れていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi had a customer come in with their grandson, Yu.
lines.style: Warm, observant recollection. Gentle voice like remembering something that made you smile. Soft pace, almost thinking aloud. A small upward lilt at the end—the pleasure of noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の俊さんと打ち合わせをされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi had a customer who was meeting with a friend, Shun.
lines.style: Quieter than the first. Still warm but more measured, like filling in a detail. Steady cadence. The tone of someone who watches people more than they speak.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、夏目漱石の「吾輩は猫である」を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi had a customer who was reading Natsume Soseki's "I Am a Cat."
lines.style: Slightly more thoughtful. A breath before the book title—respect for the literary reference. Slower, more deliberate. Voice settles into quiet admiration.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の遙ちゃんの七五三の写真を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi had a customer show her photos of their granddaughter Haruka's shichigosan celebration.
lines.style: Brighter than before. Genuine warmth breaking through. Gentle lift on the photo moment. Slower on "shichigosan"—the word carries the weight of family pride.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様の諒くんが受験を頑張ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi had a customer whose child, Ryo, is working hard on entrance exams.
lines.style: More grounded, slightly concerned undertone. A small pause before "entrance exams"—the weight of it. Voice carries quiet empathy for the struggle.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お庭のゆりの花を眺めてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi had a customer who was looking at the lilies in their garden.
lines.style: Gentler again, more wistful. Softer articulation. Like conjuring a small, peaceful image. Slight fade on the final word—the contentment of stillness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、姪御さんの綾ちゃんを連れていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi had a customer come in with their niece, Aya.
lines.style: Lighter, a touch of brightness returning. Warm but not effusive. Steady, gentle cadence. The voice of someone noting something tender without making a show of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店の朱塗りの看板をお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi had a customer who complimented the shop's vermillion sign.
lines.style: Quieter, more intimate. A slight smile in the voice—pleasure at being noticed noticing. Slower on "vermillion." Trailing off softly, like a small moment of connection held gently.
